currentParagraphText: “Guess we can both go if you want to keep things fair,” Maja said as she stood up. Jake followed suit as he would have felt awkward if he’d kept sitting. Maja had likely caught on to Jake being unsure how to approach the father and son, and decided to give him a hand.
